direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Name under a photograph
hero.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph fills the top 58% of the 1440×900 viewport, touching the top, left and right edges, `object-fit: cover`, with its focal point in the upper two-thirds. The lower 42% is a flat ground colour that butts against the photograph with no gap. The name runs across this band on one line, spanning all 12 columns between 24px margins, at clamp(120px, 19vw, 300px), tracking -0.05em, line-height 0.85, its baseline 28px above the bottom edge so descenders nearly touch it. Fit the size to the length of the name so it never wraps. In the strip of ground between photograph and name, 24px under the photograph's edge, sits one row at 17px: the supporting sentence on columns 1–5 at the left margin, and the single action as a small solid rectangular button flush to the right margin. Navigation is four text links at 15px laid over the photograph's top-right corner, 24px in, with a neutral scrim behind that row only if the image is light there. No logo is repeated: the name is the logo. Nothing else is on the screen.
hero.mobile: The photograph takes the top 50svh at full width, re-cropped around its focal point. The name sits under it at 23vw on one line; a name longer than seven characters breaks onto two lines at 21vw, line-height 0.85, and fills the band down to a 16px bottom margin. The supporting sentence at 16px and the action button stack above the name on the left margin. The links collapse to one 'Menu' word over the photograph, top-right.
hero.headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters at 19vw (drop towards 13vw for longer names), and at most two lines on a phone.

photos.title: Fog and quiet
photos.note: misty, muted, minimal landscapes and empty horizons; calm areas for text
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

motion.name: Scaling wordmark
motion.description: The giant name responds to the scroll: as the first screen leaves, the wordmark scales down a few percent (or grows from 0.94 to 1 as the footer arrives) on a scroll-linked timeline, so the monument feels heavy. Travel stays under 8%. Static fallback where scroll timelines are unsupported. Recipe: 'Scroll-linked progress' in references/motion.md, animating `scale`.

sections.name: Full-bleed sequence, text interlocked
sections.blueprint: Three photographs, each 100vw by 100svh, shown one after another with nothing between them. Each is `position: sticky; top: 0` inside a wrapper 300svh tall, so the second slides up over the first and the third over the second like a curtain; no scroll hijacking. The section above interlocks with the first photograph: a narrow paragraph at 13–14px, 220px wide, sitting on the column line at 58% of the width, is pulled down with a negative bottom margin so its last four lines overlap the photograph's top edge, in a colour that reads on both ground and image. Each photograph carries one caption line at 15px in white at the bottom-left margin, over a neutral dark scrim limited to the lowest 120px. No heading. Choose three frames with the same light and a calm lower-left corner. The last photograph releases into the next section.
sections.mobile: Each photograph is 100vw by 88svh in a portrait crop and still sticks so the next covers it. The interlocking paragraph sits at the left margin, 60% wide, overlapping the first photograph by three lines. Captions stay bottom-left at 14px.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Portrait and offset quotation
sections.blueprint: A 12-column row on the page ground with wide margins. A portrait of the speaker, 3:4, fills columns 2–5 and is tall, about 70svh; it takes whatever mask the page gives its photographs (square corners, or the page's one motif shape). The quotation occupies columns 7–12 and starts 120px lower than the top of the portrait: four to six lines at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light or regular weight, leading 1.2, measure about 26ch. The name and role sit 32px beneath the quotation at 16px, on its left edge. A second, small photograph (1:1, columns 10–11) hangs 96px below the attribution and shows the place or the thing the speaker is talking about. There is no heading. Nothing is centred; every edge lands on a column line, and the two vertical offsets are the design.
sections.mobile: The portrait runs at 72% width from the left margin, 3:4. The quotation follows at 24px, full width, starting 32px beneath. Name and role sit under it. The small second photograph sits at 44% width against the right margin, 48px lower, overlapping nothing.

sections.name: One verb at a time
sections.blueprint: Three to five full-bleed panels, each 100svh tall, stacked with no gap; each is one stage and holds one photograph covering it. In every panel a single word, the verb for that stage ('Cut', 'Fold', 'Stitch', 'Press'), is set at clamp(96px, 17vw, 300px), heavy and centred, inside a wrapper that is position: sticky; top: 50% and shifted up by half its own height. Because each word is sticky only within its own panel, it holds the centre of the screen while its photograph passes behind it, and is then pushed out by the next panel's verb. Use mix-blend-mode: difference in white, or one solid colour tested on every image. One sentence at 18px sits in the bottom-left corner of each panel over a neutral scrim limited to that corner. There is no separate heading: the verbs, read in order, are both the heading and the sequence.
sections.mobile: Panels stay 100svh, each photograph cropped to a vertical slice. The verb is 24vw, still sticky at the centre. The sentence sits along the bottom over a scrim at 16px, full width with 16px margins.

sections.name: Three photographs, then a field
sections.blueprint: Two parts with no gap between them. First, a strip of three photographs butted edge to edge across the full viewport, each one third wide and 40svh tall, `object-fit: cover`, no gutters and no captions; give all three the same treatment. Directly beneath, a band in one flat palette colour, about 44svh tall. In the band, columns 1–7: the closing statement at 26–30px over three lines in the band's assigned ink, with exactly one phrase underlined by a 4px bar (`text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 6px`), and that phrase is the link; two lines at 16px follow 32px lower. In the lower-right corner, columns 11–12, a small portrait photograph (4:5, about 150px wide) sits 40px from the band's edges: the person who will answer. There is no button; the underlined phrase is the action.
sections.mobile: The strip becomes one full-width photograph at 4:3 with the other two side by side beneath it at half width each, still gutterless. The band follows: statement at 22px, the two small lines, and the portrait at 96px wide in the bottom-right corner.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.

references.name: Tengile Malamala Collection
references.idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
references.hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
references.type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
references.colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
references.imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
references.layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.

references.name: Zara Webb
references.idea: A one-woman newborn-care practice presented like a hand-made keepsake: a mascot rabbit, scalloped and flower-shaped cut-outs, candid film photographs.
references.hero: Split exactly in half. Left, on cream: two-line mono caps nav stacks sit at the column's top-left and top-right with a handwritten script logo centred between them. Centred below, a five-line headline in a condensed serif, each line broken to one to three words so the block forms a ragged lozenge; then a three-line 16px sans paragraph and an outlined pill button in mono caps. A line-drawn rabbit on a skateboard rides a hairline at the column's bottom-right. Right: a candid flash photograph bleeds off the top and right edges and stops at 92% height; a lilac pill button and a round chat icon overlay its top-right corner.
references.type: Instrument Serif Regular for headings (52 to 57px, plus a 9.4vw footer wordmark), its italic for subheads and service names; Inter Tight for small body copy; PT Mono uppercase for nav, buttons and tiny captions; a script logo. Parenthesised italic numerals number the services.
references.colour: #fffdf1 #403630 #ece4d2 #e2c9f7 #cfe195 #f6e7e4 — Warm cream page with cocoa-brown text and two brown panels. Lilac marks the main pill button and footer wordmark; a sage-green pill marks a secondary action. Warm throughout.
references.imagery: Candid flash and film photos of babies and carers, some grainy black-and-white, cropped into non-rectangular masks (four-petal flower, scalloped egg) or small rounded portraits; plus black line doodles with halftone-dot fills: a recurring rabbit, flowers, a rattle, a bottle.
references.layout: 20px margins. Centred serif statements with small centred paragraphs alternate with split or inset blocks: a brown rounded panel, a half-photo half-beige block. Services run as a two-column hairline list. Doodles are tucked beside headlines; the footer's top edge is scalloped.

sections.description: A dark brown panel with about 11px radius, inset 20px from the page. Left half: a three-line cream serif statement at about 56px and below it a photograph masked into a four-lobed flower about 540px across, cropped by the panel's bottom, with two tiny mono captions floating beside its lobes. Right, from 63%: two blocks, each an italic serif subhead over a four-line small paragraph, then two flower doodles, a caps line and a lilac pill button.

A centred two-line serif heading and a four-line centred paragraph. Below, a two-column list inset to the middle 72% of the width; each item opens with a hairline, then a parenthesised italic numeral, the service name in italic serif at about 32px and a three-line small description. Rows are tall with generous empty space; the final cell swaps to a faded question prompt with the rabbit doodle.

A half-and-half block. Left: a grainy black-and-white extreme close-up of a baby's eye and cheek, full-bleed, overlapped from the bottom by a cream cut-out shaped like an egg with a scalloped top; it holds an italic serif subhead, a five-line centred paragraph, a caps line and a sage pill button. Right: a flat beige field with a centred two-line serif heading and a small rounded portrait about 230px wide flanked by two tiny mono captions.

Dark brown, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops about 120px wide. A centred three-line serif statement in cream with bottle and flower doodles at its shoulders and a waving rabbit beneath; two small centred text blocks at far left and right; contact lines and four social icons; then the name in lilac serif at 9.4vw, cropped by the bottom edge, with tiny mono legal text in both corners.

steal: Mask photographs into soft custom shapes (a four-petal flower, a scalloped egg) and let their container crop them.
Cut a section's top edge into a row of semicircles so a plain colour change becomes a motif.
Break a centred serif headline into very short lines so it forms a deliberate ragged shape, and anchor it with one small line drawing sitting on a hairline.
